comparisons.reason: Feature 0 is broader: any comment with specific empirical evidence, including studies, research findings, and documented real-world cases or observations with specific details, even if non-numerical. Feature 1 requires specific numerical data or statistics (figures, percentages, rates, counts) and explicitly excludes non-quantitative examples. A detailed non-numeric documented case would score 1 on 0 and 0 on 1, so the construct and eligibility differ.
